hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: Let F(t)=polygamma(1,t). G0001 is F(z). For G0002 define O_series[F](t)=Sum_{k=0}^{\infty} 1/(k+t)^2; then G0002 is O_series[F](z). For G0003 define O_diff[F](t)=F(t)-O_series[F](t); then G0003 is O_diff[F](z).
required_assumptions: z is not a nonpositive integer
k runs over nonnegative integers in the sum
proof_obligations: O_series[F](t) - F(t) = Sum_{k=0}^{\infty} 1/(k+t)^2 - polygamma(1,t) = 0 for t not a nonpositive integer
G0003 = polygamma(1,z) - Sum_{k=0}^{\infty} 1/(k+z)^2 = 0 under the stated assumptions
hypotheses.rationale: The catalog members share the single latent function F(t)=polygamma(1,t); G0002 is the infinite-series form, G0001 is the closed form, and G0003 is their difference.
